description: Use before sending or processing an email when you need current preflight facts about the address. For $0.001 USDC on Base mainnet, the existing Email Preflight API checks six facts: syntax validity, domain availability, MX availability, disposable-email detection, role-account detection, and free-provider detection. Example paid result shape: { email: "user@example.com", syntax: "valid", domain: "exists", mx: "found", disposable: "not_listed", role_based: "not_detected", free_provider: "not_detected" }. MX records do not prove that a mailbox exists. Unpaid requests return the original upstream HTTP 402 challenge. A compatible x402 client may retry with its own signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. This adapter never signs, owns a wallet, or settles independently.
name: email_preflight
title: Email Preflight
